environment.description: Container deployed on GKE Autopilot with pod security context specifying readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or tmpfs volume mounts defined in the pod spec. The container's entire filesystem layer is mounted read-only at the kernel level via the OCI runtime spec (runc rootfs propagation set to 'ro'). The secret at /var/run/secrets/ws-frame-key is mounted as a Kubernetes Secret volume (projected, read-only). Node-level gVisor (runsc) sandbox enforces VFS read-only semantics independently of container configuration. Istio sidecar provides mTLS for all mesh traffic but WebSocket upgrade is permitted through VirtualService configuration.
